lyra.greeting: The fence still needs work, but the yard looks better with you here.
lyra.trust_3: I trust you with the southern plots now.
lyra.trust_6: Come walk with me after dusk if you want.
lyra.romance_gate: Only if you mean it — I need to hear the words.

sable.greeting: The moths are quiet tonight. Good for listening.
sable.trust_3: You see more than most. That is rare.
sable.trust_6: Stay a while. The night is kinder with company.

mara.greeting: Sun's still high. Keep your weapons clean.
mara.trust_3: You fight well enough. Don't get cocky.
mara.trust_6: I could use a partner who watches my back.
